countryConfig.title: Countries
countryConfig.intro: Addresses store the country as free text. Shipping costs and delivery countries need an unambiguous country: every free text that occurs is listed here with its assignment. Assign the unassigned ones manually.
countryConfig.companyCountry: Addresses without a country count as the company country: {text} → {country}
countryConfig.allAssigned: All free texts are assigned to a country.
countryConfig.loadError: The countries could not be loaded.
countryConfig.saveError: The assignment could not be saved.

shippingConfig.title: Shipping methods
shippingConfig.movedHint: The shipping methods with their zones and rates have their own view in the shop menu.
shippingConfig.intro: Shipping methods with carrier, rank, limits and price tiers. If the items of an order have different shipping methods, the highest-ranked applies; items without an assignment get the cheapest suitable one. eBay calculates shipping itself via the shipping policy.
shippingConfig.zonesHint: Prices apply per zone. A country belongs to at most one zone; countries without a zone fall under “All other countries”.
shippingConfig.noZones: No zones yet — all price tiers apply to all countries.
shippingConfig.deleteZoneConfirm: Delete zone “{name}”? Its countries and all price tiers of this zone will be deleted too.
shippingConfig.noActiveMethod: There is no active shipping method — without one, no order is possible in the shop.
shippingConfig.deleteMethodConfirm: Delete shipping method “{name}”? Its price tiers will be deleted too; items it was assigned to get the cheapest suitable one again.
shippingConfig.partSectionHint: A service used only by this shipping method: its description appears on the invoice, its posting group determines revenue account and tax. Never offered in the shop.
shippingConfig.partnumberLocked: Appears on invoices — can no longer be changed
shippingConfig.maxGirthHint: Length + 2 × width + 2 × height of the largest item
shippingConfig.maxWidthHint: Width = middle side of the item, however it lies in the parcel. Empty = no limit
shippingConfig.maxHeightHint: Height = shortest side of the item, e.g. for letters or small packets. Empty = no limit
shippingConfig.maxSizeHint: Size as defined by Hermes: longest + shortest side. Empty = no limit
shippingConfig.ebayPolicyHint: empty = the general one from the eBay settings
shippingConfig.freeShippingAppliesHint: From the channel's free shipping threshold, this shipping method is free.
shippingConfig.ratesHint: Prices {art}. The most specific tier applies: own channel before all channels, own zone before all other countries, then the highest weight and quantity tier reached.
shippingConfig.noRates: Without a price tier this shipping method delivers nowhere.
shippingConfig.duplicateRate: A tier appears twice (same channel, same zone, same limits).
shippingConfig.costHint: What the carrier charges, net. Shown in the item card only; empty = not maintained.
shippingConfig.loadError: The shipping methods could not be loaded.
shippingConfig.saveError: The change could not be saved.

channelConfig.countriesHint: Delivery only to these countries. Empty = all countries.
channelConfig.excludedDeliveryTerms: Do not offer on eBay with delivery terms
channelConfig.excludedDeliveryTermsHint: eBay cannot represent long delivery times. Items with one of these delivery terms are not offered on eBay; existing listings are ended.
channelConfig.freeShippingFromHint: Gross order value from which shipping is free — for shipping methods with “free shipping threshold applies”. Empty = no threshold.
channelConfig.title: Sales channels
channelConfig.intro: Defaults per channel for all articles without their own markup. The base price is the article's sales price.
channelConfig.activeLast: At least one sales channel must be enabled.
channelConfig.round99Hint: 12.30 becomes 12.99 and 13.00 becomes 13.99. A price ending in .99 stays.
channelConfig.round99NetWarning: Sales prices are stored net. The net price is derived from the rounded gross price; invoices may differ from the cart by one cent. Recommended: keep sales prices gross (setting above).
channelConfig.invalidPercent: A discount of 100 % or more is not possible.
channelConfig.republishQueued: Saved. The product pages will be rewritten with the new prices.
channelConfig.saveError: The channel settings could not be saved.
channelConfig.loadError: The sales channels could not be loaded.
channelConfig.secretsLoadError: The sales channel keys could not be loaded.
channelConfig.name: Name
channelConfig.autoAddPartsHint: When an item is newly added to the shop, it is offered in this channel as well.

channelConfig.settingsSaveError: The settings could not be saved.

channelConfig.deleteConfirm: The files are deleted from this article and from the library. If another article references a file, it is kept there.
